name: Start the story and inspect the photograph
covers: main logo display with asset upload
description: Verifies the main journey from the title screen into the first scene and records an environmental clue.
steps: Open the home screen
Select VISUAL CODEX
Verify the sub-logo is visible in the persistent top navigation
Select VISUAL CODEX and verify the collage or its upload fallback
Select BACK TO HUB
Select ENTER THE HOUSE
Select BEGIN EXPLORING
Select OLD PHOTOGRAPH
Open JOURNAL
expected: The home screen identifies the build as Developer Beta. The sub-logo appears in the persistent top navigation; after the main logo upload, title artwork is visible; the Visual Codex displays the collage or its upload fallback. The entrance-hall scene opens, the photograph discovery is recorded, and the journal displays the observation.

name: Retain discoveries after reload
description: Verifies discovered objects and journal entries persist after reloading the browser.
steps: Start the story and inspect the photograph
Collect the brass key
Reload the page
Continue the story
Open the journal
Open Settings and create a Security Vault passphrase with at least 12 characters.
Seal the current story progress and download the encrypted backup.
Lock the vault and attempt to unlock with an incorrect keeper identity.
Unlock using The Archivist and the correct passphrase, then import the downloaded backup and confirm restoration.
expected: The photograph and key remain collected and the journal retains their clue entries. The Security Vault also protects a separate encrypted snapshot, rejects the wrong keeper identity or passphrase, and restores only after confirmation.

name: Use the correct memory layer to solve the bedroom
description: Verifies that clues must be read through their assigned reality layer and that a correct layered investigation unlocks the next night.
steps: Enter the house and inspect the old photograph and brass key
Open CHAPTERS and select The Silent Library
Set the catalogue words to MEMORY, HOUSE, NAME, RETURN and check the sequence
Return to CHAPTERS and open The Room That Remembers
In Present, inspect Back of the photograph
While still in Present, attempt to inspect Stopped clock and observe that the layer guardrail blocks it
Switch to Memory and inspect Stopped clock
Switch to Reflection and inspect Mirror inscription
Select 1961 and solve the mechanism
Open CHAPTERS and verify The Overgrown Garden is unlocked
expected: The house rejects the clue in the wrong layer, records each clue only in its matching layer, accepts 1961 after all three clues are found, and unlocks Night 03.

name: Complete entrance-hall discovery on mobile
description: Verifies exploration controls remain available at a mobile viewport.
steps: Open the story at a mobile viewport
Start the story and begin exploring
Tap the brass key hotspot
Tap the antique mirror hotspot
Open the journal
expected: Touch hotspots are visible and tappable and both discoveries are listed in the journal.

name: Validate account sign-in and preserve progress on reset cancellation
description: Verifies account input validation is visible and canceling a destructive reset preserves existing story progress.
setup: Start the story and inspect the photograph
steps: Open Settings
Verify the ACCOUNT & CLOUD SAVE panel and the email and password fields
Leave the email address blank and click SIGN IN
Verify the inline email validation message appears and no sign-in is completed
Choose RESET STORY PROGRESS
Cancel the browser confirmation
expected: The account form clearly rejects a blank email, does not start sign-in, and canceling the reset leaves the existing story progress unchanged.
